worked_solution:
Note that we can rewrite this integral as

$$
{\int }_{3}^{6}\frac{9}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}-3}}\,\text{d}x=3\sqrt{3}{\int }_{3}^{6}\frac{1}{\sqrt{{(\frac{x}{\sqrt{3}})}^{2}-1}}\,\text{d}x.
$$

This integral resembles the basic integral for inverse hyperbolic cosine,

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{{u}^{2}-1}}\,\text{d}u=\operatorname{arcosh}⁡u+C.
$$

The only difference is that instead of ${u}^{2}$ as the variable, we have ${(\frac{x}{\sqrt{3}})}^{2}.$

So, let's substitute $u=\frac{x}{\sqrt{3}}.$ Differentiating, we get

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\,⟹\,\text{d}x=\sqrt{3}\,\text{d}u.
$$

Before substituting, we use the table below to change the limits from $x$ to $u.$

| $x$ | $3$ | $6$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $u$ | $\sqrt{3}$ | $2\sqrt{3}$ |

Using the above, we can now write the integral in terms of $u$ and evaluate:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{3}^{6}\frac{9}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}-3}}\,\text{d}x & =3\sqrt{3}{\int }_{3}^{6}\frac{1}{\sqrt{{(\frac{x}{\sqrt{3}})}^{2}-1}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =3\sqrt{3}{\int }_{\sqrt{3}}^{2\sqrt{3}}\frac{1}{\sqrt{{u}^{2}-1}}\cdot (\sqrt{3}\,\text{d}u) \\  & =9{\int }_{\sqrt{3}}^{2\sqrt{3}}\frac{\text{d}u}{\sqrt{{u}^{2}-1}} \\  & =9\operatorname{arcosh}⁡u{|}_{\sqrt{3}}^{2\sqrt{3}} \\  & =9(\operatorname{arcosh}⁡2\sqrt{3}-\operatorname{arcosh}⁡\sqrt{3}) \\  & =9(\operatorname{ln}⁡(2\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{{(2\sqrt{3})}^{2}-1})-\operatorname{ln}⁡(\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{{(\sqrt{3})}^{2}-1})) \\  & =9(\operatorname{ln}⁡(2\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{11})-\operatorname{ln}⁡(\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2})) \\  & =9\operatorname{ln}⁡(\frac{2\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{11}}{\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{2}})\end{aligned}
$$
